decisions.reason: The instruction to use image labels concerns assessment of chapter fit; it does not change the existing decision to include chapter images or their integration timing.
The supplied chapter images and label-based fit assessment do not affect title-page content or formatting.
The source changes how chapter images are assessed and does not modify manuscript prose or the approved editorial rewrites.
Providing images for editorial-fit review does not change the requirement to advise the client about paperback publication.
The source concerns chapter-image review materials and labels, not integration of the client's highlighted manuscript revisions.
